# Bundled front-end libraries

Served by the app itself under `web/vendor/`, so the dashboard needs no internet access for its own UI and isn't blocked by browser tracking protection.

| Library | Version | Licence | Source |
|---------|---------|---------|--------|
| uPlot | 1.6.32 | MIT (see `uplot/LICENSE`) | https://github.com/leeoniya/uPlot / `uplot@1.6.32/dist` |

Files are unmodified copies of the published `dist` builds (checked against the npm package `uplot-1.6.32.tgz`).
